sql:
SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, CAST(JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) / 365 AS Age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU >= 180 AND L.`T-CHO` < 250
GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
